### AllocationStrategy {#type-commerz-inventory-allocation-contracts-allocationstrategy}

`Commerz\Inventory\Allocation\Contracts\AllocationStrategy`

Proposes where demand is held, contributed under kind `allocation_strategy`. Pure: no I/O, no clock, no state between calls. Inventory validates the plan and owns locking, so a strategy may leave needs unplaced but can never place more than the sources hold.

```php
interface AllocationStrategy {
    const KIND = 'allocation_strategy';
    allocate(\Commerz\Inventory\Allocation\Data\AllocationRequest $request): \Commerz\Inventory\Allocation\Data\AllocationPlan;
    // Sellable units of the need this strategy could place from the sources; null when stock does not limit it.
    capacity(\Commerz\Inventory\Allocation\Data\AllocationNeed $need, array $sources): ?int;
    key(): string;
}
```

### StockItemStatus {#type-commerz-inventory-items-enums-stockitemstatus}

`Commerz\Inventory\Items\Enums\StockItemStatus`

`active ⇄ archived`; an archived item takes no stock and no new links.

```php
enum StockItemStatus {
    case Active = 'active';
    case Archived = 'archived';
}
```

### StockPolicy {#type-commerz-inventory-items-enums-stockpolicy}

`Commerz\Inventory\Items\Enums\StockPolicy`

How reservations treat the item's stock: `tracked` reserves only free stock, `backorder` reserves beyond it (consuming still needs physical stock), `untracked` is always available and keeps no levels.

```php
enum StockPolicy {
    case Tracked = 'tracked';
    case Backorder = 'backorder';
    case Untracked = 'untracked';
}
```

### UntrackedStockItem {#type-commerz-inventory-items-exceptions-untrackedstockitem}

`Commerz\Inventory\Items\Exceptions\UntrackedStockItem`

An untracked item keeps no levels: stock cannot be placed on it, and the policy cannot change to it while stock is held, reserved or unresolved in a transfer.

```php

    public readonly string $sku;
    __construct(string $sku, ?string $message = null);
    category(): \Commerz\Errors\ErrorCategory;
    code(): string;
    context(): array;
    // Stock was placed on an untracked item.
    static keepsNoLevels(string $sku): self;
}
```

```php
    public readonly int $released;

    public readonly string $sku;
    public readonly int $units;

}
```

### StockLevels {#type-commerz-inventory-stock-contracts-stocklevels}

`Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Contracts\StockLevels`

Physical stock of an item at a location. Every on-hand change writes one journal movement; a change that leaves the level short of its reservations and safety stock succeeds and reports `StockShortfall`. Archived items and locations accept only changes that lower on-hand, so they can be emptied. Mutations join the caller's transaction.

```php
interface StockLevels {
    adjust(\Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\AdjustStock $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\StockLevelView;
    count(\Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\CountStock $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\StockLevelView;
    level(\Commerz\Inventory\Items\Data\StockItemId $item, \Commerz\Inventory\Locations\Data\LocationId $location): \Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\StockLevelView;
    list(\Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\ListStockLevels $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    receive(\Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\ReceiveStock $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\StockLevelView;
    setSafetyStock(\Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\SetSafetyStock $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Stock\Data\StockLevelView;
}
```

### Transfers {#type-commerz-inventory-transfers-contracts-transfers}

`Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Contracts\Transfers`

Moves stock between two locations: `draft` (the units are reserved at the source) → `in_transit` (they left the source) → `completed` (received at the destination, less what was written off). The goods in transit sit on no level, only on the transfer's lines. One shipment per transfer; every command takes the transfer row first, so concurrent commands on a transfer run one after the other.

```php
interface Transfers {
    // A cancelled transfer stays cancelled; a repeat returns it.
    cancel(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\CancelTransfer $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferView;
    create(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\CreateTransfer $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferView;
    dispatch(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\DispatchTransfer $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferView;
    find(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferId $id): \Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferView;
    list(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\ListTransfers $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    receive(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\ReceiveTransfer $command): \Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferView;
}
```

### ReceiveTransfer {#type-commerz-inventory-transfers-data-receivetransfer}

`Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\ReceiveTransfer`

```php
    __construct(\Commerz\Inventory\Transfers\Data\TransferId $transfer, array $lines, ?\Commerz\Identity\IdempotencyKey $idempotencyKey = null);
}
```
